name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace. There is no JavaScript in this repo; these scripts are named entry points for the stdlib-only Python/shell self-checks, so agents, contributors and CI all invoke the same commands. check:ci is what .github/workflows/ci.yml runs; check:all adds the PDK-dependent sim stages, which need ngspice >= 46 and the gf180mcu PDK installed locally.

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && sim/selftest.sh
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run test && sim/selftest.sh --require-pdk
